headlines.description: — Daylen Lile homered and drove in two runs as part of a three-hit day, and the Washington Nationals beat the Colorado Rockies 7-1 to split their four-game series Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Daylen Lile homers as Nationals top Rockies 7-1 to split 4-game series

events.name: Baltimore Orioles at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Blaze Jordan and Ramón Urías homered early to help the St. Louis Cardinals beat the Baltimore Orioles 7-5 on Thursday, snapping a five-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jordan and Urías homer as Cardinals beat Orioles 7-5 to snap 5-game losing streak

events.name: Houston Astros at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Christian Walker had three hits, including a two-run homer off Gerrit Cole in the sixth inning, and Jeremy Peña added a solo shot to power the Houston Astros to a 5-1 victory over the New York Yankees on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Christian Walker and Jeremy Peña power the Astros to a 5-1 win over Gerrit Cole and the Yankees

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Jac Caglianone had a homer among his career-best five hits and finished with a career-high six RBI, Noah Cameron pitched six strong innings and the Kansas City Royals beat the Toronto Blue Jays 13-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caglianone goes 5 for 6 with HR, 6 RBIs to power the Royals past the Blue Jays 13-2

events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Jackson Chourio went 4 for 5 with two homers, four RBI and four runs to help Jacob Misiorowski and the Milwaukee Brewers beat the New York Mets 8-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson Chourio and Jacob Misiorowski lead the Brewers to an 8-2 victory over the Mets

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Atlanta Braves

headlines.description: — Chris Sale struck out 11 in a five-hit shutout, Drake Baldwin launched a leadoff homer against Yoshinobu Yamamoto, and the Atlanta Braves edged the Los Angeles Dodgers 1-0 on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Chris Sale strikes out 11 in 5-hit shutout as Braves beat Yamamoto and Dodgers 1-0 for 3-game sweep

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Drew Gilbert homered and drove in the go-ahead run, Landen Roupp pitched five solid innings and the San Francisco Giants beat Arizona 6-1 on Thursday night to snap a four-game home losing streak against the Diamondbacks.
headlines.shortLinkText: Drew Gilbert homers and Landen Roupp pitches 5 solid innings as Giants beat Diamondbacks 6-1
